ERW Steel pipe
Straight seam resistance-welded steel pipe supplier
Electric Resistance Welded Steel Pipe (ERW pipe) is a straight-seam welded steel pipe made by heating and welding steel strips using high-frequency resistance welding. Also called straight-seam resistance-welded pipe. Compared with seamless steel pipes, it has higher precision and lower cost, and is widely used in construction, oil and gas transportation, and urban pipeline networks.
Glory Steel,
 as a leading ERW pipe manufacturer in China, possesses advanced welding production lines. It can produce pipes with outer diameters ranging from OD 20 mm to 610 mm and wall thicknesses from 2.0mm to 20mm, and can perform post-processing processes such as oil coating, galvanizing, PE coating, and threading.

Key Features
1. 
Advanced Production Technology
ERW pipes are produced through an 
electric resistance welding process
, using hot-rolled or cold-rolled low-carbon steel coils as raw materials.The welding process ensures stable mechanical properties and reliable quality.
2. 
High Dimensional Accuracy & Smooth Surface
No extra welding materials are needed during production.The pipes have uniform chemical composition, precise dimensions, and smooth surface, which is good for coating adhesion.
3.

Black pipe

4. 
Cost-Effective & Customizable
ERW production line features high welding speed (20–200 meters per minute) and low material loss. Sizes, length, material grade, and surface treatment can be customized according to project requirements.
electric resistance welded steel pipe Factory
ERW pipe for natural gas
Application Areas
Oil and Gas Transportation: ERW straight seam welded pipe is one of the mainstream pipe types in natural gas, crude oil, and petroleum product (API 5L grade) pipelines, often used alongside spiral submerged arc welded pipe (SSAW) and straight seam submerged arc welded pipe (LSAW).
Building Structures: High-rise building frames, bridge load-bearing structures, piling projects, and scaffolding pipes, etc.
Municipal Pipelines: ERW steel pipes are widely used in urban gas, heating, and water supply and drainage systems due to their good sealing performance and high pressure resistance.
Industrial Pipelines: Process pipelines in chemical plants, power plants, and mines; furniture and sports equipment pipes, etc.

Manufacturing Process of ERW Steel Pipe
Hot-rolled/cold-rolled steel coils → slitting into 
strips
 → edge treatment & butt welding → roll bending → high-frequency welding → deburring (internal & external) → sizing & straightening → non-destructive testing & hydrostatic testing → length cutting → surface treatment → marking & packaging.
Forming technologies: Commonly include FFX flexible forming and URD forming. The former is suitable for various specifications, while the latter is suitable for medium and large diameter pipes.
Welding methods: Divided into contact welding and induction welding, with frequencies generally between 350-450 kHz; the weld is formed by the fusion of the base material itself.
Surface treatment: galvanizing, black paint coating, 3PE anti-corrosion coating, etc.
Non-destructive testing: Ultrasonic testing (UT) and eddy current testing (ET), and hydrostatic testing according to standard requirements. End treatment: Can be finished with flat ends, chamfering, threads, and pre-welded flanges.

What is the difference between ERW pipe and seamless steel pipe?
ERW pipe is a welded pipe with a straight weld seam, offering high precision and low cost. 
Seamless steel pipe
 has no weld seam, with a one-piece molded structure, resulting in relatively lower precision and a higher price.
What is the difference between ERW steel pipe and spiral welded pipe?
ERW pipe has a shorter weld seam and higher forming precision. Spiral welded steel pipe is welded using spiral coiled plates, resulting in a spiral weld seam that is longer. High-end projects have prioritized ERW or UOE pipes.
Can you provide custom lengths and coatings?
Yes, we support delivery in fixed lengths of 4–18 meters or multiples thereof, offering galvanized coating, 3PE anti-corrosion coating, FBE fusion-bonded epoxy powder coating, and black paint/rust-preventive oil surface treatment.
What certifications does your ERW steel pipe have? 
We hold API SPEC 5L certification, ISO 9001 quality management system certification, and compliance certifications for standards such as GB/T 9711, ASTM A53, and EN 10217, and provide material reports for each batch.‌
